attchmntText: Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication-Notice to Shareholders
voiceSummary: Oil India Limited published a notice on 16th November 2026 regarding a special window for the transfer and dematerialisation of physical securities. This window remains open until 04th February 2027. It applies to physical securities sold or purchased prior to 1st April 2019. It also covers re-lodgement of transfer deeds previously rejected or returned due to document deficiencies. Securities transferred during this period will be issued in demat mode. Shareholders are advised to comply with SEBI circular conditions dated 30th January 2026. Contact details for Registrar KFin Technologies Limited are provided. Shareholders holding physical shares must complete KYC with the Registrar to claim unpaid dividends. Nectar Lifesciences Limited filed an extract of unaudited results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The consolidated net profit after tax for the half year was 494.49 lakhs. The standalone net loss after tax for the half year was 1,267.37 lakhs. Earnings per share for the consolidated half year was 0.30. The standalone earnings per share for the half year was negative 0.65.

attchmntText: Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Audio Recording
voiceSummary: Oil India Limited has uploaded the audio recording of the conference call held on 13th November 2026 regarding the financial results for Q2 of FY 2026-27. The recording is available on the company website under Investor Services. The company confirms that no unpublished price sensitive information was shared during the call. Management attendees included Shri Saloma Yomdo, Shri Abhijit Majumder, Shri Trailukya Borgohain, Shri Sachidananda Maharana, Shri Raghunath Mishra, and Shri Abhijit Das. This filing is submitted in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 20-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: Oil India Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 12th November 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026 on both Standalone and Consolidated bases, along with the Limited Review Report by Auditors. The company declared an Interim Dividend of Rs. 71 per share, representing 70% of paid-up capital for the financial year 2026-27. The Record Date for determining shareholder eligibility for this dividend is set as Friday, 20th November 2026. Payment of the Interim Dividend is scheduled to be made on or before 12th December 2026. The Board Meeting commenced at 11:30 a.m. and concluded at 1:30 p.m.

attchmntText: Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "OIL reported 20% growth in crude oil production resulting to 116% growth in Standalone PAT during Q2 FY27".
voiceSummary: Oil India Limited reported financial results for Q2 FY27 following its Board meeting on 12th November 2026. The company recorded a 20% growth in crude oil production and a 116% increase in Standalone Profit After Tax to Rs. 2,259 crore. Consolidated PAT rose 53% to Rs. 2,521 crore. The Board recommended an interim dividend of Rs. 7.00 per equity share. Crude oil price realization increased by 35% to USD 92.24 per barrel. Subsidiary NRL achieved a 265% growth in Gross Refining Margin to US$ 28.24 per barrel. The refinery maintained capacity utilization of over 100%. The company drilled 42 wells in the first half of the year.

attchmntText: Oil India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period Quarter and Half-year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Oil India Limited Board of Directors meeting held on 12th November 2026 approved Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board declared an Interim Dividend of Rs. 71 per share, representing 70 percent of paid-up capital for the financial year 2026-27. The dividend shall be paid on or before 12th December 2026. The Record Date for ascertaining shareholder eligibility is set as Friday, 20th November 2026. The financial results include a Limited Review Report from auditors RKP Associates and OPTotla & Co. The auditors noted an Emphasis of Matter regarding provisions for Service Tax and GST liability on royalty, totaling Rs. 5,283.85 crore as at 30th September 2026. Additionally, the report highlights a contingent liability of Rs. 2,484.81 crore raised by the Government of Assam. The auditors also noted non-compliance with the Companies Act 2013 regarding the number of Independent Directors and the absence of a Woman Director during the period.
